verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's CLI documents running tasks locally, and a community user praises Dev mode for testing and iterating. Nothing shows that one command runs the whole engine locally, and there is no evidence of testing utilities. Missing for 10: evidence that a single command runs the full engine locally (not just task execution), unit-testing utilities, time skipping, mocked steps.

support.subject: As a backend developer, one command runs the whole engine locally, and testing utilities let me unit-test workflows with time skipping and mocked steps

citations.quote: The Trigger.dev CLI has a number of options and commands to help you develop locally, self host, and deploy your tasks.
Also want to call out the Dev mode: it's an absolute gem, makes testing and iterating so much smoother than anything else I've tried.
